body: Refusal of imposed authority: you reject the rules of a system that did not earn your respect. Ambition shaped, and often pressured, by status and demanding early expectations, with a quiet frustration at social standards. Unintegrated it can over-control or misuse position; owned, it turns that authority toward helping others structure and steady their lives, and the reminder is to extend that care to yourself too.
business: Owned, this builds authority on your own terms.
shadow: Suppressed it becomes bitter compliance; unchecked, cold defiance and control.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
